title: IRC service: link: an attachment's HMAC URL
description:
Mark asked for these four on 2026-11-22, after the MIMID raw verb landed (a59a7497).

IRC has no attachment story and DCC is not it. The agent already serves GET /attachment/... on its loopback HTTP listener, checked by AttachmentLinks::check under a key derived from the local token, with an expiry (docs/design/agent-frontends.md §7.30). Work: 'link <#channel> <n>' mints that URL for the nth attachment of a message and NOTICEs it, so the user pastes it into a browser. Note in the reply that the link carries its own authority and expires.
